name: YOOPAI Silk Tri-Color PLA @Creality Ender-3 Pro
filament_notes:
YOOPAI manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Manufacturer max speed 250 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed raised to 18 mm3/s (printer profile 12) from the manufacturer's 250 mm/s rating, capped at 18 for this printer.
Temperature set for ~45 mm/s on this printer: 200 C (first layer 200 C). Manufacturer bands: 190-215 C at 50-150 mm/s; 215-230 C at 150-250 mm/s. Printing much faster or slower than this printer's default process? Adjust the nozzle temperature along those bands.
3-in-1 coextrusion silk (Red Blue Green, Black Purple Blue, Red Gold Purple, Red Yellow Blue). Not on yoopai.com. The Amazon listing text (B0GTTQMQ82) gives no settings; the only published settings are the gallery image shared with the Dual Color line: 190-215C @50-150 mm/s, 215-230C @150-250 mm/s, 'Dry before printing' (no temperature or time). Nozzle range and max speed are the envelope of those two bands. Bed and drying not published. Also sold in a 4 x 250g tri-colour bundle. +/-0.03 mm.
Source: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GTTQMQ82
